# ONVIF WSDL/XSD snapshot

- Upstream: https://github.com/onvif/specs
- Commit: `b0ae7de3dc3ca9b5ca27629385f48167cacc715a`
- Imported content: `wsdl/` only.

The snapshot keeps ONVIF binding generation reproducible and prevents a future upstream WSDL
change from silently changing the generated C++ API. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).
